newsitem.title: USA: Spiegel sees Q3, Q4 net below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Spiegel sees Q3, Q4 net below estimates.

text.p: Spiegel Inc, which reported lower August sales, said Thursday it expects earnings for its third and fourth quarters to fall below current analysts' estimates due to a weakness in catalog sales.
Spiegel also said it expects to perform better in this year's third quarter compared to last year.
Catalog sales in August declined primarily due to weak response rates in the Spiegel and Newport News catalog divisions, the company said in a statement.

First Call estimates Spiegel's third quarter results at a loss of $0.09 a share and fourth quarter results at a profit of $0.45 a share. In the third quarter last year, Spiegel reported a loss of $0.21 a share.

Earlier today, Spiegel reported total sales for the four weeks ended August 24, 1996 fell 11 percent from the same period a year ago to $176.7 million from $199.5 million in the same period last year.
Spiegel said comparable-store sales for its Eddie Bauer subsidiary decreased six percent for the four-week period.
Spiegel is a specialty retailer which markets apparel and home furnishings through catalogs, more than 400 stores and online services.
